title: Article 113 — Procedure in Parliament with respect to estimates

content.overview: Article 113 provides that estimates relating to expenditure charged upon the Consolidated Fund of India shall not be submitted to the vote of Parliament (though discussion is allowed), and that other estimates are submitted in the form of demands for grants to the House of the People. The House of the People may assent, refuse to assent, or assent subject to a reduction of the amount. No demand for a grant may be made except on the recommendation of the President.
content.glance: Charged expenditure: not votable (discussable). Other estimates: demands for grants in LS. LS may assent, refuse, or reduce. Presidential recommendation required for demands.
content.study:
Article 113:
(1) Estimates of charged expenditure are not submitted to the vote of Parliament; discussion in either House is permitted.
(2) Other estimates are submitted in the form of demands for grants to the House of the People; the House may assent, refuse to assent, or assent subject to a reduction.
(3) No demand for a grant shall be made except on the recommendation of the President.

Examination: charged vs demands for grants; LS exclusive voting on grants; Presidential recommendation; link to Appropriation Bills (Art 114).

sections.heading: Procedure
sections.body:
1. Charged expenditure: no vote; discussion allowed.
2. Other expenditure: demands for grants in Lok Sabha only.
3. LS may assent / refuse / reduce.
4. Demand only on Presidential recommendation.

questionsAndAnswers.question: Explain Article 113.
questionsAndAnswers.answer: Under Article 113, estimates of expenditure charged on the Consolidated Fund of India are not submitted to the vote of Parliament (though they may be discussed). Other estimates are submitted as demands for grants to the House of the People, which may assent, refuse, or assent subject to a reduction. No demand for a grant may be made except on the recommendation of the President.

examTips: Charged not votable; demands for grants in LS; Presidential recommendation.

keyTakeaways: Art 113: charged not votable; demands for grants in LS on Presidential recommendation.
